prompt: In lru.js export a class LruCache. new LruCache(capacity, options) where capacity must be a positive integer (otherwise throw RangeError, including for undefined, null, strings and NaN) and options may hold ttlMs (a positive number of type number, otherwise throw RangeError; absent means entries never expire) and now (a function returning the current time in milliseconds, default Date.now). set(key, value) stores the value, marks the key as most recently used, restarts its time to live (get and has never extend it), returns the cache itself, and when the number of live entries would exceed capacity it evicts the least recently used live entry. get(key) returns the value and marks the key most recently used, or undefined when the key is absent or expired. has(key) reports whether the key is present and not expired and does NOT change recency. delete(key) returns true if a live entry was removed and false otherwise. size() returns the number of live entries. keys() returns an array of live keys from least to most recently used. An entry is expired when now() >= the time it was set + ttlMs. Expired entries never count toward size or capacity, are never returned and never evicted in place of a live entry. A stored value may be undefined (has still reports true). Keys are compared with SameValueZero, so NaN is a usable key and 1 and '1' are different keys.
